text.arabic_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍۢ

words.gloss_range: coordinating connective; locally links the earth panel to 50:6 while opening a new terrestrial beat
words.prose: The opening {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes 50:7 begin as continuation, not as an isolated new description: the earth panel is pulled forward from the sky-observation frame of 50:6 while also launching a fresh terrestrial turn. Its fused position before the earth noun makes the opening relational, so sky, earth, anchors, and growth accumulate into one visual catalogue with forward pressure toward seeing-based admonition in 50:8.

topics.headline: sky-to-earth continuation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the earth signs as continuing the observation frame of 50:6 rather than starting a detached scene.
topics.reason: Boundary and particle evidence support coordination with 50:6 while still allowing the ayah to launch a terrestrial panel.

topics.headline: relational visual bridge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the initial connector as a visible launch form that binds 50:6 to 50:7 and points forward to visual admonition in 50:8.
topics.reason: The proclitic form, waṣl row, and forward bridge row make the connector both a written launch and a boundary bridge.

words.gloss_range: the known earth as fronted affected substrate; physical land/ground is selected over political territory or abstraction
words.root_gloss_range: earth, land, ground, lower surface, and fertile soil associations; locally narrowed to the physical substrate acted on by extension, anchoring, and growth
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضَ}} ({{tr:al-arḍa}}) is placed before its verb and then resumed by the object suffix, so the earth is foregrounded first and remains grammatically affected rather than becoming an independent subject. The word names the familiar earth as one unified lower substrate: ground under the prior sky scene, capable of receiving anchors and producing growth, while broader root-family hints such as fertility or instability stay subordinate to the local surface-and-substrate sense. Same-surah and cross-surah rows also make this earth part of a larger creation arc, from extension formulas such as 15:19 and 13:3 to the later earth-splitting scene in 50:44.

topics.headline: fronted affected object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the earth set in view before the action and then resumed inside the verb as the same affected object.
topics.reason: Accusative fronting plus the resumptive suffix in the following verb gives the word its local syntactic force.

topics.headline: known unified substrate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the familiar earth is treated as one stable nominal platform that receives the ayah's three divine actions.
topics.reason: Definiteness, singular feminine form, and exclusive nominal usage support a known and unified substrate reading.

topics.headline: lower, fertile, anchor-needing ground
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses why extension, anchoring, and growth belong together: the earth is lower ground, a receiving surface, and growth-capable soil.
topics.reason: Root-family and boundary evidence add lower-ground, fertility, and instability pressure, while local grammar keeps the meaning to physical earth/ground.

topics.headline: creation and same-surah arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can place this earth within the wider Quranic creation formula and the surah's own movement from prepared surface to later rupture.
topics.reason: Rows cite earth-extension parallels at 15:19 and 13:3, a same-surah return at 50:44, and the sky-to-earth boundary movement.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect directed extension of the earth; supply/provision branches are backgrounded by the local form and object suffix
words.root_gloss_range: stretching, extending, drawing out, and supplying; locally narrowed to direct physical spreading with provision pressure only through the later growth sequence
words.prose: {{ar:مَدَدْنَٰهَا}} ({{tr:madadnāhā}}) closes the fronting construction by carrying both the divine agent and the earth-object suffix in one completed verb. The surface Form I makes the first act tactile and spatial: the earth is drawn out as a prepared plane, not merely supplied or reinforced, though the root's provision branch quietly fits the later growth outcome. In the ayah's architecture this is the first completed act before casting and growth, and it mirrors the sky-building verb of 50:6 by shifting from upward construction to outward extension.

topics.headline: completed directed extension
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one completed divine act directed at the already-fronted earth, not a vague or intransitive spreading event.
topics.reason: The perfect first-plural verb with object suffix resumes the fronted earth and marks a transitive completed act.

topics.headline: Form I physical spreading
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the selected form favors direct physical spreading while the supply branch remains a secondary resonance through later growth.
topics.reason: Form I and the earth object narrow the broad m-d-d field away from Form IV reinforcement/supply as the governing local sense.

topics.headline: expansion and result state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels extension as outward expansion with an achieved extended state, not just a flat geometric label.
topics.reason: Flood-swelling and passive-participle evidence support a concrete expansion/result nuance without displacing the local spreading sense.

topics.headline: first act in cosmic sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first verb as the horizontal counterpart to sky-building in 50:6 and as the prepared surface for the next two acts.
topics.reason: Boundary and texture rows align 50:6 sky-building with 50:7 earth-extension and place this verb first in the substrate-anchor-growth progression.

words.gloss_range: additive coordinator before the second divine act; sequence is logical without marking a delayed then
words.prose: The middle {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resets the line after the completed extension and introduces casting as a second coordinated act. It keeps preparation and anchoring distinct, while its fused written form and clipped recurrence make the creative sequence feel like enumerated beats rather than one blurred predicate.

topics.headline: second coordinated act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees anchoring as the next listed divine act, coordinated with extension without a marked temporal delay.
topics.reason: The particle links finite verbs additively and sequentially, but the evidence does not require thumma-like delay.

topics.headline: audible and visual beat separation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees a reset that preserves extension and casting as two separate creative beats.
topics.reason: Orthographic fusion to the verb and repeated short connector rows support an enumerating beat function.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect casting/placing; locally controlled emplacement of anchors into earth, not mutual encounter or chaotic throwing
words.root_gloss_range: meeting, receiving, casting, throwing, depositing, and causing to meet; locally narrowed by Form IV, locative, and object to directed stabilizing placement
words.prose: {{ar:أَلْقَيْنَا}} ({{tr:alqaynā}}) is the middle verb of the triad: a completed first-plural act that casts the anchors into the earth. The broad l-q-y field of meeting and receiving is narrowed by Form IV, the locative frame, and the stabilizing object, so the payoff is controlled emplacement: the mountains are made to meet the earth by directed placement rather than by mutual convergence or random hurling. The same root later appears in punitive casting scenes in 50:24 and 50:26, making this constructive placement the creation-side contrast inside the surah.

topics.headline: agent, object, interior location
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a full placement frame: divine agent, cast stabilizers, and the earth as interior receiving location.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links the verb to both the locative complement and the direct object.

topics.headline: caused meeting by placement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the meeting-root pressure as directed emplacement: the anchors are caused to meet the earth, but the local verb is casting, not mutual encounter.
topics.reason: Form IV activates causative direction and blocks Form I meeting, Form V receiving, and Form VIII mutual convergence as governing local senses.

topics.headline: creation formula and judgment contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the familiar mountain-casting formula and also hears a same-surah contrast between constructive creation and later punitive casting.
topics.reason: Rows cite creation collocations at 31:10, 16:15, and 15:19, plus later same-root commands in 50:24 and 50:26.

topics.headline: middle hinge of triad
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the casting verb as the stabilizing hinge between extension and growth, not a side note.
topics.reason: The verb is introduced by one connector and followed by another, occupying the middle slot of the coordinated three-act sequence.

words.gloss_range: in it/into it with feminine suffix resolving to the earth; locative frame for anchor placement
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) keeps the fronted earth present without renaming it, and the referent is the earth rather than the feminine sky-pronoun chain from 50:6. Because it follows a casting verb, the phrase carries both location and direction: the anchors are placed in or into the earth, and the same phrase will return with growth to bind stabilization and life-production to one earth-container.

topics.headline: earth as interior container
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pronoun switches to the earth and that the anchors are framed as inside it, not merely on it.
topics.reason: Referent and attachment evidence resolve the suffix to the earth and connect the prepositional phrase to the casting verb.

topics.headline: compact preposition-pronoun form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees how a short fused form sustains the earth reference without repeating the noun.
topics.reason: The preposition plus feminine suffix compresses the locative relation and antecedent into one form.

topics.headline: first half of repeated locative frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same earth-location frame later with growth, making anchors and plants share one container.
topics.reason: Rows identify the exact local repetition at words 6 and 10 and its dual-interiority effect.

words.gloss_range: anchoring ones/stabilizers, with mountains primary; active participial plural names function, not only topography
words.root_gloss_range: firmness, anchoring, ship-rest, fixed structures, and sinking into place; locally narrowed to mountain-stabilizers cast into the earth
words.prose: {{ar:رَوَٰسِىَ}} ({{tr:rawāsiya}}) resolves what was cast into the earth: not a named mountain set, but multiple stabilizing anchors. Its active participial plural makes anchoring a property carried by the noun itself, so the mountains are grammatically the cast object and semantically the fixing ones. The root's ship-anchor and sinking-to-bottom images strengthen the picture of fixed stabilizers inside the earth, while cross-surah creation rows show this as a recurring mountain-anchor formula rather than decorative scenery.

topics.headline: cast object as active anchors
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the object of casting as active stabilizers, not inert scenery or a merely topographic label.
topics.reason: Accusative object grammar combines with active participial plural form to make the noun both object and stabilizing role.

topics.headline: anchor-root image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the mountains as earth-anchors sunk and fixed, while the local context keeps mountains primary.
topics.reason: The r-s-w field supports anchoring, ship-rest, and sinking images, but local object position and creation collocation select mountain-stabilizers.

topics.headline: technical creation formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a semi-technical creation-sign term repeated in earth-mountain passages such as 13:3, 15:19, 16:15, 21:31, 27:61, and 31:10.
topics.reason: Distribution and echo rows show the noun recurring in a concentrated creation-sign formula with earth and casting language.

topics.headline: middle stabilization landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the middle clause land with mass and stability before the ayah turns to growth.
topics.reason: Texture, boundary, and phonetic rows make the word the heavy landing of the stabilization panel.

words.gloss_range: coordinator before the third divine act; adds growth as an independent but logically final beat
words.prose: The third {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the growth clause as a new coordinated act, not a mere result phrase attached to anchoring. Its recurrence completes the short connective refrain: extension, anchoring, and growth remain distinct, but the sequence now moves toward its climactic productive panel.

topics.headline: third coordinated act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees growth as its own divine act while still feeling its logical place after stabilization.
topics.reason: The third connector coordinates the growth verb with the previous finite verbs without subordinating it.

topics.headline: connective refrain completed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the repeated connector complete a three-beat frame and cue the climactic growth clause.
topics.reason: Fusion to the growth verb, clause separation, and repeated sound rows support a coordinated refrain.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect caused growth; local frame has earth-location plus partitive specification rather than an overt direct object
words.root_gloss_range: sprouting, vegetation, emergence, production, and cultivation/rearing; locally narrowed to divine causative production of botanical growth from the earth
words.prose: {{ar:أَنۢبَتْنَا}} ({{tr:anbatnā}}) turns the prepared and anchored earth into a productive site. Form IV makes growth caused by the divine speaker rather than spontaneous plant emergence, and the verb carries the ayah's fullest complement chain: in the earth, from every delightful pair or kind. Broader sprouting and rearing branches add emergence-from-substrate and cultivated-growth color, but the local payoff is direct divine production. This third verb also opens the longest clause and links 50:7 to nearby rain and provision language in 50:9 and 50:11.

topics.headline: causative divine growth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees growth as caused production by the divine speaker, not as plants simply sprouting on their own.
topics.reason: Form IV morphology and first-plural perfect form make the verb causative and agentive.

topics.headline: full location and specification frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the growth clause is structurally fuller than the earlier acts, with earth-location and total paired diversity unfolding after the verb.
topics.reason: Attachment and texture evidence give the verb a locative complement plus the final partitive/specifying phrase.

topics.headline: emergence and cultivated-growth pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels growth as emergence from a substrate and cultivated production, while the local form keeps direct causative growth as the selected sense.
topics.reason: Root-family evidence supports sprouting and rearing pressure; local Form IV and botanical complement chain prevent those branches from becoming separate local senses.

topics.headline: climactic provision arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the third verb as the climactic productive step that continues into rain and provision scenes in 50:9 and 50:11.
topics.reason: Same-surah and texture rows place this growth verb in a local progression from creation signs toward provision.

words.gloss_range: in it, again referring to the same earth; growth-location before the partitive specification
words.prose: The second {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) repeats the same earth-pronoun phrase from the anchoring clause, so the growth scene does not shift to a new container. Its position before the partitive phrase first fixes the earth as the stage and productive matrix, then lets the range of grown pairs unfold; the local echo links buried anchors and emerging plants through one repeated interior reference.

topics.headline: same earth as growth location
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees growth located in the same earth that received the anchors, not in a newly introduced setting.
topics.reason: Attachment and referent evidence connect this phrase to the growth verb and resolve the suffix to the same earth antecedent.

topics.headline: location before specification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the order: the earth is established as place and matrix before the phrase unfolds every produced kind.
topics.reason: The second locative phrase immediately precedes the partitive phrase, combining location with origin/specification.

topics.headline: repeated locative echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a structural echo tying mountains below the surface to plants emerging from the same earth.
topics.reason: Rows identify exact repetition with word 6 and describe the local echo between anchoring and growing clauses.

words.gloss_range: from/of, partitive and specifying preposition opening the final quantifier phrase
words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) is the small gate into the ayah's closing specification. It governs the following quantifier and makes the growth phrase read as from or of every kind, not as a bare object list. Because it comes after the locative, the structure first fixes the earth as the stage and then narrows and universalizes what grows there through the nested sequence from every pair or kind.

topics.headline: partitive governance of total phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the final phrase is governed as from/of every kind, not simply another direct object.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the quantifier and attaches to the growth verb as a partitive/specifying complement.

topics.headline: partitive and explanatory force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the preposition both extracting from a total field and explaining the produced range.
topics.reason: Particle evidence allows partitive, explanatory, and source force converging in this final construction.

topics.headline: gate into nested specification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the closing chain as location first, then partitive opening, then universal pair, then delight.
topics.reason: Texture rows present the preposition as the opening of the nested final phrase after the locative.

words.gloss_range: every/all as a genitive construct quantifier; distributive totality through the following pair/kind noun
words.root_gloss_range: totality, completeness, and related exhaustion/encircling imagery; locally narrowed to distributive universality over paired or kinded growth
words.prose: {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) is the hinge that turns the final phrase from source into exhaustive diversity. Because it is genitive after the preposition and construct before the next noun, its totality is not vague allness: it distributes item by item through every pair or kind. Root-family images of completion, spentness, or encircling can color the sense of no member left outside, but local grammar keeps the payoff to distributive universality inside the creation-growth formula echoed in 51:49, 36:36, 31:10, 26:7, 22:5, and 13:3.

topics.headline: construct distributive totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees every as item-by-item coverage of paired kinds, not a loose collective total.
topics.reason: Construct state and the following indefinite noun complete the quantifier as distributive universality.

topics.headline: governed hinge of final chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this word is both governed by the preposition and governing the next noun, making it the hinge of the closing phrase.
topics.reason: Case and construct relations place the quantifier between the preposition and the paired-kind noun.

topics.headline: completion pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels totality as completed coverage, while related exhaustion or encircling images remain coloring rather than alternate local meanings.
topics.reason: Root-family evidence supports completion pressure, but local usage selects the common quantifier sense.

topics.headline: creation totality echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes that a very common quantifier becomes specialized here as exhaustive botanical classification within a wider every-pair formula.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence and echo rows tie the quantifier to growth and paired creation across several cited passages.

words.gloss_range: pair, counterpart, mate, kind, or type; locally a singular indefinite category under every, holding pairhood and taxonomy together
words.root_gloss_range: joining, pairing, spouse/mate, counterpart, pair, kind, and type; locally narrowed to paired botanical kind as the distributed category
words.prose: {{ar:زَوْجٍ}} ({{tr:zawjin}}) is the noun over which every is distributed and to which the final adjective attaches. Its singular indefinite form keeps the category open, while the root's pair/kind range lets biological complementarity and taxonomic variety coexist: each unit is a kind and still carries a paired or counterpart structure. Because the noun, not a derived pairing verb, is used, pairhood appears as a created category; it holds the closing phrase's scope and beauty together and joins the wider paired-creation wording cited at 51:49, 36:36, 31:10, 26:7, 22:5, and 13:3.

topics.headline: open category under every
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the noun as the open category distributed by every, not a fixed list of named species.
topics.reason: Genitive construct relation and indefiniteness make the noun the category over which the quantifier ranges.

topics.headline: pair and kind held together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps both complementarity and classification in view: the growth is organized through paired kinds rather than isolated items.
topics.reason: Lexical rows support pair, mate, counterpart, kind, and type together in the botanical context.

topics.headline: created pairhood as noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees pairhood as a created category in the noun, while derived verbal pairing agency stays outside the local form.
topics.reason: The root has pairing verbs, but the local surface is a noun, so the valid payoff is nominal created pairhood rather than an action of pairing.

topics.headline: hinge between scope and delight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this noun receives both the universal scope before it and the delight adjective after it.
topics.reason: Agreement, construct relation, and final-phrase rows make the word the semantic center between quantifier and adjective.

topics.headline: paired-creation echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears this botanical pair/kind wording as part of broader Quranic complementarity language, not as an isolated taxonomic term.
topics.reason: Rows cite cross-surah paired-creation references and sense-shift across spouses, pairs, kinds, and passive pairing.

words.gloss_range: delightful, joy-giving, or delighted-in; genitive indefinite adjective of the paired kind, not of the earth generally
words.root_gloss_range: beauty, splendor, gladness, delight, joy-causing and delighted-in force; locally narrowed to an enduring delight-quality assigned to each produced pair or kind
words.prose: {{ar:بَهِيجٍ}} ({{tr:bahījin}}) closes the ayah by assigning beauty and joy to each produced pair or kind, not to the earth in general. Its genitive indefinite agreement locks it to the preceding noun, and the faʿīl pattern lets the quality work both ways: the kind delights and is delighted in, joining visible beauty with observer response. Because the root is rare and tied to creation-growth contexts such as 22:5 and 27:60, the ending is marked rather than generic; the three-act creation sequence lands on enduring aesthetic delight, answering the sky's adornment in 50:6 and preparing the visual-instruction uptake in 50:8.

topics.headline: adjective attached to each kind
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees delight assigned to every produced pair or kind, not spread vaguely over the whole earth.
topics.reason: Agreement and genitive governance bind the adjective to the preceding noun inside the final phrase.

topics.headline: beauty and joy response fused
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps both sides of the adjective: the grown kind is joy-producing and also something delighted in.
topics.reason: Role and lexical evidence support active and passive faʿīl readings and a root field joining beauty with delight.

topics.headline: enduring intensive quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the closing quality as stable and structural, not fleeting prettiness.
topics.reason: The faʿīl pattern and adjective rows support enduring or intensive quality.

topics.headline: rare creation-growth marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes that this is a marked creation-growth adjective, echoing the small botanical delight set at 22:5 and 27:60.
topics.reason: Distribution rows identify the root as rare and restricted to earth/growth creation-sign contexts.

topics.headline: aesthetic closure and visual arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah land on delight as the outcome of creation, linking sky adornment in 50:6 to visual admonition in 50:8.
topics.reason: Texture and boundary rows make the final adjective the aesthetic landing of the ayah and a bridge from 50:6 to 50:8.

topics.headline: soft paired cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the noun-adjective pair close with matching soft cadence that fits the semantic landing on delight.
topics.reason: Phonetic rows bind the final noun and adjective through matching tanwīn cadence and soft closure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence 'earth / We extended it / We cast in it firm fixtures / We caused to grow in it every delightful kind.'
baseline_models.mechanism: Spatial extension makes a broad substrate, emplacement supplies fixed points, and caused growth fills that stabilized field with an encompassing diversity whose quality is visible freshness.

activation_trace.role: The fertile, soft earth supplies the receptive and productive substrate in the mechanism.
Drawing something out continuously supplies the field's breadth and connected extension.
Casting supplies deliberate emplacement of the stabilizing masses into the field.
Fixity and rootedness make the cast features function as stable points rather than loose objects.
Agentive planting and causing-growth turns the prepared field into productive output.
Comprehensive enclosure of parts makes the output a field-wide range rather than one specimen.
A color or class of a thing organizes the growth into distinguishable botanical kinds.
Freshness and visual beauty mark successful flourishing as the sequence's perceptible result.

changed_reading.before: A flat earth has mountains and attractive plants.
changed_reading.after: The ayah depicts an engineered generative field: breadth is stabilized, then made to issue an ordered plenitude whose freshness shows that the system is working.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The collocation of 'madadnaha' with repeated 'fiha' and agentive 'anbatna.'
baseline_models.mechanism: The extension can carry a latent sense of connected increase and replenishing material, so the earth is not merely stretched once but configured as a supplied medium whose received support becomes growth and joy.

activation_trace.role: Connected increase that supports another supplies a continuing support relation within 'extended.'
Water replenished by other water provides an exploratory material model for extension as a supply network.
The fertile ground is the recipient that can convert supply into abundant growth.
Plant emergence is the visible conversion of latent support into living output.
Joy makes flourishing not only visual output but an experienced benefit.

changed_reading.after: Extension can also name a connected capacity to receive and transmit sustaining increase, with delighted growth as its downstream effect.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The scoped phrase 'min kulli zawjin bahij.'
baseline_models.mechanism: Totalizing scope combines two live senses of zawj, counterpart and kind: abundance is ordered by relations and classes, while bahij makes that ordering both fresh in appearance and joy-producing.

activation_trace.role: Wholeness and encompassing scope distribute the claim across the field's kinds.
A counterpart joined to its counterpart keeps relational pairing alive beside the botanical sense.
A color or class grounds the immediate sense of varied botanical kinds.
Delight supplies the affective consequence of perceiving ordered abundance.

changed_reading.after: The growth is a comprehensive but articulated abundance: kinds and counterparts remain distinct, and their ordered coexistence elicits delight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sky is assembled, beautified, and denied fissures; the focus earth is extended, fixed, and beautified through growth. The two adjacent sequences form complementary upper and lower construction panels, with beauty functioning as evidence of ordered integrity in each.

activation_trace.role: The lower realm opposite the sky anchors the focus half of the vertical pair.
Continuous breadth supplies the lower panel's spatial formation.
Fixity supplies integrity in the lower panel.
Visible freshness parallels the upper panel's adornment.
Joining components into a building supplies deliberate construction above.
Making beauty manifest supplies the upper analogue to the focus ayah's fresh beauty.
An opening between things, explicitly negated there, supplies the sky's seamless integrity.

structural_cues: 50:6 and 50:7 are adjacent 'how We...' inspections, moving from sky above to earth below.
Both panels end in a perceptible aesthetic or integrity result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent constructed/adorned sky and extended/stabilized/flourishing earth; I infer that adjacency and parallel verb chains make them complementary panels. A live alternative is that they are cumulative signs without strict mirroring.

changed_reading.before: The ayah independently describes terrestrial features.
changed_reading.after: It is the lower half of a coordinated cosmic build: spatial formation, integrity, and adornment are displayed above and below through different materials.

context_deltas.mechanism: The landscape's beauty is assigned a cognitive function: visible order becomes heart-level insight, a reminder restores what is not presently attended to, and that restoration is effective for one who repeatedly turns back.

activation_trace.role: Visible freshness gives perception an attractive, inspectable object.
The encompassing range lets repeated kinds reinforce the same perceptual lesson.
Insight of the heart changes looking at the landscape into recognition.
A reminder assigns the preceding created scene a restorative cognitive role.
Habitual return identifies the receptive posture that converts the sign into remembrance.

structural_cues: 50:8 directly follows the sky-earth inspection and gives it the paired functions 'tabsirah' and 'dhikra.'
The focus ayah's beauty is therefore not ornamental surplus alone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the created scene followed by insight/reminder for a returning servant; I infer a causal arrow from sensory beauty to recognition and renewed orientation. The alternative is that 50:8 scopes over the whole sky-earth unit rather than 50:7 specifically.

changed_reading.before: The delightful vegetation is an attractive created object.
changed_reading.after: Its delight is an interface for return: patterned beauty recruits sight, restores a latent recognition, and repeatedly reorients the receptive observer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context supplies a full material chain: delivered water bearing stable increase enters the same growth process, a dead land is made alive, and that transition is explicitly aligned with exit. The focus ayah's earth-growth system therefore models emergence from death rather than merely seasonal fertility.

activation_trace.role: Water replenishing and extending water supplies a latent transport layer for the following explicit water sequence.
Fertile ground supplies the receiving matrix in which revival becomes visible.
Human growth and nurture keep bodily emergence available within the focus root's branch range.
Caused descent and delivery supplies the initiating transfer into the terrestrial system.
Water delivered by irrigation or pouring supplies the material carrier of revival.
Stable, growing good makes the water's effect enduring increase rather than a transient wetting.
Earth's life through rain and vegetation explicitly names the state transition enacted by growth.
Lifeless land supplies the depleted initial state from which the transition begins.
Passage to the outside supplies the endpoint that maps plant emergence onto resurrection.

structural_cues: 50:9 repeats 'anbatna' from the focus and 50:11 closes the water-growth chain with 'thus is the exit.'
The focus ayah's repeated 'fiha' locates both fixtures and emergence inside the earth before the later exit from it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, water, growth, enlivening dead land, and an explicit comparison to exit; I infer that 50:7 is the compact system diagram expanded in 50:9-11. A live alternative is a narrower analogy from revived land, not every detail of 50:7, to bodily resurrection.

changed_reading.before: The ayah celebrates ordinary terrestrial fertility.
changed_reading.after: It diagrams resurrection materially: a prepared earth receives life-bearing supply and converts hidden potential into visible emergence, making human exit conceivable through a recurrent process.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus sequence does not only recover a prior plant; it continuously produces distinct kinds. The later contrast between first creation and a new creation activates growth as evidence for measured origination and fresh formation, complementing the return model without collapsing into it.

activation_trace.role: A place and origin of emergence makes the earth a formation site, not only a storage place.
Human development and nurture permits a cautious transfer from botanical formation to embodied formation.
Distinct kinds show formation issuing in differentiated configurations.
Origination and bringing creation into being supplies the capability questioned in both first and new creation.
New occurrence after a break supplies discontinuity and fresh formation, not only restoration of a previous surface state.

structural_cues: 50:15 contrasts 'the first creation' with 'a new creation' after the earth-growth proof sequence.
The focus produces every kind, emphasizing differentiated output rather than one repeated specimen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies first/new creation and the focus supplies agentive differentiated growth; I infer that recurrent origination demonstrates capacity for newly formed embodiment. The live alternative is that 'new' denotes restoration of the same persons without stressing configurational novelty.

changed_reading.before: Plant growth is chiefly an analogy for life returning after death.
changed_reading.after: The differentiated growth also witnesses fresh formation: the earth is a workshop of repeatedly new configurations, so resurrection may be understood as renewed origination as well as return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The connected increase latent in 'madadnaha' is later polarized by the same word for 'more': Hell asks whether there is further intake, while the garden has further gift. Extension becomes morally directed capacity, not neutral endless quantity.

activation_trace.role: Connected increase and support anchors the focus ayah to the later language of additional capacity.
Joy marks the beneficent pole toward which one form of increase can be directed.
Increase and growth supplies Hell's open demand for additional intake.
The same increase supplies an open surplus of gift at the garden pole.

structural_cues: The surah places 'mazid' in both destination sequences, once as appetite and once as gift.
The focus joins extension to delightful growth, giving increase a beneficent baseline that the later polarity complicates.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two opposed occurrences of 'more' and the focus branch supplies connected increase; I infer that capacity itself is ethically neutral until its direction is disclosed. The alternative is that the two 'mazid' occurrences concern only destination scale and do not revise terrestrial extension.

changed_reading.before: The earth's extension is spatial and beneficent.
changed_reading.after: Extension activates a broader capacity for continued increase whose destination matters: the same openness can image devouring demand or inexhaustible gift.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate water-growth expansion names tree-covered gardens, while the later singular garden is driven near. This recurrence turns the focus ayah's delightful kinds into a present, inspectable preview whose botanical category is continuous with the promised destination without making the two identical.

activation_trace.role: Vegetation emerging from earth supplies the present material from which the preview is formed.
Delight supplies the experiential continuity between present growth and promised garden.
A garden screened by trees identifies the focus growth's immediate developed form.
Movement into nearness makes the promised garden a proximate destination rather than a remote abstraction.
The repeated garden category links the destination back to the earlier terrestrial growth sequence.

structural_cues: 50:9 develops the focus growth into gardens; 50:31 reuses the garden noun in the destination sequence.
The later garden is 'brought near,' matching the focus ayah's appeal to presently visible delight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated garden language, present growth, and eschatological nearness; I infer a preview relation from the visible instance to the promised destination. The alternative is simple lexical continuity between two gardens without an anticipatory function.

changed_reading.before: The delightful kinds are benefits confined to the present landscape.
changed_reading.after: They are also near-field samples of promised abundance: present botanical delight lets a future garden enter perception before it is entered bodily.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same earth first appears broad, fixed, and generative, then opens rapidly so a gathered population can emerge with ease. Stability is therefore staged rather than absolute: it serves habitation and growth until the surface's function reverses from holding and nurturing to releasing and assembling.

activation_trace.role: Soft fertile earth anchors the surface first as a medium that receives and nurtures life.
Fixity supplies the initial holding function whose later reversal is striking.
Emergence of plants prefigures movement from inside the earth to its exterior.
Splitting and opening changes the earth from containing surface into release aperture.
The opposite of slowness supplies the release process's sudden tempo.
Driving and collecting a group to one end supplies the social endpoint of material emergence.
Opening and ease after difficulty presents mass release as unimpeded.

structural_cues: 50:7 and 50:44 name the earth at opposite ends of the surah's proof and fulfillment arc.
The focus's inside-location 'fiha' is answered by the later opening 'anhum' and rapid gathering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed fertile earth in the focus and rapidly splitting earth at gathering; I infer a designed functional reversal from holding to release. The alternative is that the two states are separate divine acts with no claim that earlier stability was temporally staged for the later opening.

changed_reading.before: Mountains make the extended earth a permanently stable habitat.
changed_reading.after: The earth's stability is a phase-specific service: it holds and grows life now, yet can become an effortless release surface that converts hidden individuals into a gathered multitude.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it recruits the branch-distant image of an earth-creature consuming wood, not the direct sense of 'earth.' It remains anchored by the focus earth and growth roots and by 50:4's explicit earth-subtraction plus preservation. Render only as a material analogy: the earth transforms deposited matter while identity is preserved elsewhere, not as a lexical claim that 50:7 means decay.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The fertile earth that receives emplacement and produces new growth.

activation_trace.role: The earth-creature that consumes wood supplies an exploratory image of terrestrial matter being actively broken down.
A site and origin of emergence makes the same earth a matrix for new formation after material loss.
Part of a thing going away supplies the explicit subtraction performed by the earth.
Guarding a thing supplies preservation that prevents material subtraction from equaling loss of identity.

changed_reading.before: Earth is a passive floor on which stable features and plants are placed.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, earth is a selective metabolizer: it subtracts and transforms deposited material, yet under preserved identity it can also become the matrix from which formed life reappears.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because it links casting mountains to casting one's hearing. The exact focus root and construction keep it anchored, while the later reminder context makes the transfer functional. Render as a formal echo: deliberate placement can stabilize a landscape or establish receptivity, not as an assertion that mountains symbolize ears.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: 'We cast in it firm fixtures,' especially the deliberate casting verb joined to the result of stability.

activation_trace.role: Casting supplies deliberate placement of something so that a downstream function can hold.
Fixity supplies the physical result of the focus ayah's casting.
Casting the hearing repeats deliberate placement in the receptive domain, making attention an act rather than a passive state.
Reminder supplies the cognitive function that attentive placement enables.

changed_reading.before: Casting in 50:7 is only the physical depositing of mountains.
changed_reading.after: As a whole-surah formal echo, casting is purposeful placement that establishes a stable relation: fixtures hold the earth, while offered hearing lets a reminder take hold in a present heart.

strongest_changes: The focus earth-growth sequence becomes a material model of reviving exit when 50:9-11 supplies water, dead land, life, and explicit emergence.
The earth's fixity becomes phase-specific when 50:44 turns the same surface into a rapid, easy release and gathering mechanism.
The landscape becomes a perceptual return device, not merely scenery, because 50:8 assigns it insight and reminder for the repeatedly returning servant.
Adjacent sky and earth sequences form complementary upper and lower demonstrations of constructed integrity and beauty.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context made one terrestrial system carry several nonexclusive functions: habitat, cognitive sign, resurrection prototype, preview of garden, and eventually a surface whose holding function reverses into release. The distant recurrence of casting at 50:37 also exposed a contained physical-to-receptive formal echo.
remaining_uncertainties: The water-supply sense activated in 'madadnaha' is lexically available but not syntactically required until 50:9.
The first/new creation distinction does not settle whether renewed embodiment should be stressed as restoration, fresh configuration, or both.
The opposed 'mazid' model is coherent but depends on a cross-root link between connected extension and increase.
The metabolizer and casting/hearing outliers should remain explicitly analogical rather than be promoted to direct lexical meanings.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Extension is stabilized and made generative.** `م د د:B001` supplies lengthwise extension, `ل ق ي:B005` casting, `ر س و:B001` settling firm, and `ن ب ت:B001` emergence of growth. The verb sequence gives extension → emplacement of stabilizers → growth; I infer that stable extension enables diversified emergence. The earth reads as an engineered productive field rather than passive scenery.
2. **Every pair is also every variety.** `ز و ج:B001` supplies paired counterpart, while `ز و ج:B004` supplies kind or variety; `ب ه ج:B001` adds radiant freshness and `ب ه ج:B002` delight. Because both variants fit the distributive `كُلِّ`, neither should be collapsed. The ayah simultaneously presents relational pairing and proliferating kinds, with beauty functioning as visible evidence of successful growth.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 50:44 surprisingly transformed the same earth from stable productive extension into a rapidly splitting release surface. Stability and opening are not contradictions: the packet presents each as a precisely timed role within one controlled material system.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Extension as a connected supply surface.** `م د د B001` supplies lengthwise extension, while `م د د B002–B003` supply connected increase and water-fed flow. The sequence fixes mountains, brings down water in 50:9, produces harvest, and names the result provision in 50:11. The packet supplies those material stages; I infer that the extended earth distributes what descends rather than merely occupying breadth. *Madadnāhā* consequently reads as laying out a connected provisioning surface.

2. **Casting as installation into a stable ecology.** `ل ق ي B005` supplies casting or setting something down, `ر س و B001` assigns the cast mountains the role of settled fixity, and `ز و ج B004` plus `ب ه ج B001–B002` make the growth diverse, visibly fresh, and affectively delightful. The ordered verbs cast–fix–germinate are supplied; I infer that what is “cast” is placed into a functional support role rather than discarded. The ayah reads as an installed ecology whose visual delight is itself routed into *tabṣirah* and remembrance in 50:8.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 50:9’s descent and 50:11’s naming of the result as provision confirmed that the earth’s extension is distributive under `م د د B002–B003`. More surprisingly, 50:11’s *khurūj* turned the installed ecology into a model of release from death rather than an isolated landscape description.

baseline.text: Yeri de yaydık, ona sağlam dağlar yerleştirdik ve onda her güzel çifti bitirdik.

findings.text: Yerin yayılması, dağlarla sabitlenip suyu ve artışı birbirine bağlı yüzey boyunca dağıtan üretken bir alan kurulmasıdır.
“Her çift”, karşılıklı eşleşmenin yanında çoğalan tür çeşitliliğini de bildirir; güzellik bu düzenli çoğalmanın görünür başarısıdır.
Burada sağlamlaştırılan aynı yerin ileride tam vaktinde yarılıp içindekileri çıkarması, sabitlik ile açılmanın tek denetimli maddi düzenin farklı görevleri olduğunu gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Göğün karşısında aşağıda bulunan, üzerinde yaşadığımız yer küresini belirtir. Belirli tamlamalarda bir şeyin yere bakan altını ve hayvanın tırnağını ya da ayağının alt bölümünü de anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kolay işlenen yer ve bitkinin hızlı yetişmesi özelliklerini daha genel biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da verimli, iyi bitki yetiştiren toprağı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yumuşaklık ve iyi bitkilenmeyle birlikte belirli bitki ve oğlak yapılarını taşır; komşu dal kolaylık ve hızlı yetişme niteliğine uzanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli yapılarda bir kişinin iyiliğe yatkın, ona layık ve alçak gönüllü oluşunu; karşılaştırmalı yapıda ise bir işi yapmaya en uygun kişi sayılmasını bildirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız verilen kişi ve eylem yapılarında geçerlidir; genel bir kök anlamı veya doğrudan ahlaki iyilik adı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım bütünüyle belirtilen kişi ve eylem tamlamalarına bağlıdır; yalın biçime bağımsız bir uygunluk anlamı yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli yapılarda bir kişinin iyiliğe yatkın ve ona layık olmasını anlatır; bir kaynak bu niteliği alçak gönüllülükle birlikte verir. Karşılaştırmalı kullanımda ise bir işi yapmaya başkalarından daha uygun olmayı bildirir.

facets.statement: Kişi iyiliğe yatkın ve ona layıktır.
Karşılaştırmalı yapıda kişi, belirli bir işi yapmaya grubun en uygun üyesidir.
Bir kaynak bu kişi niteliğini alçak gönüllülükle birlikte verir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, iyiliğe yatkınlık ve layıklık ile belirli bir eyleme en uygun olma yargısını yapı bağımlı tek bir uygunluk alanında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kişi hakkında kurulan belirtilmiş yapıda dalın temel niteliğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: İyiliğe yönelme, uygunluk, layıklık ve olumlu kişilik değerlendirmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluk içinden belirli işi yapmaya en uygun kişi seçildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli eyleme başkalarından daha uygun ve layık olma karşılaştırmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: İyiliğe yatkın ve alçak gönüllü kişi niteliğini dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: iyiliğe yatkın, layık ve alçak gönüllü kişi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İyiliğe yatkınlıkla birlikte alçak gönüllülük çağrışımı ve belirli kalıplara bağlılık taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Herhangi bir şeye hazır, uygun veya layık olmayı daha geniş biçimde anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir kişi ile uygun görüldüğü nitelik veya eylem arasındaki yatkınlık ilişkisini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal iyilik alanına ve iki belirli yapıya bağlıdır; komşu dalın uygunluk ve hazır oluş kapsamı daha geneldir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm komşular değerlendirildi; genel layıklık alanıyla karışma olasılığı en yüksek olan karşılaştırma yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynak ifadesi, sabit bir adlandırmanın doğrudan yabancı kimse anlamına geldiğini belirtir; yer sakini veya soy bağına ilişkin daha ayrıntılı bir koşul kurmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu anlam yalnız sabit adlandırmaya aittir ve genel olarak yeryüzünde yaşayan kişiyi anlatmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız kanıtlanan sabit söz birimine bağlanır; parçaların yalın anlamlarından yeni bir kişi sınıfı türetilmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir sabit adlandırmada, bulunduğu çevreye dışarıdan gelen veya oraya ait olmayan yabancı kimseyi belirtir.

facets.statement: Sabit söz birimi, bir yerde yabancı olan kimseyi adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kanıt, söz biriminin yabancı kimseyi belirten kısıtlı ve kalıplaşmış bir adlandırma olduğunu gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kanıtlanan sabit adlandırmanın kişi anlamını doğal biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin bulunduğu yere veya topluluğa ait olmaması anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yabancılığı herhangi bir ek topluluk koşulu vermeden sabit bir adlandırmayla bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişinin kendisinden olmayan bir topluluğun içine girmiş bulunmasını özellikle belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bulunduğu insan çevresine aslen ait olmayan kişiyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın kanıtı yalnız yabancı olmayı söyler; komşu dal yabancının başka bir topluluk içinde bulunması koşulunu açıkça taşır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday kartlar değerlendirildi; genel yabancı anlamına en yakın, fakat topluluk koşuluyla ayrılan komşu seçildi.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس ساكن الأرض مطلقا ولا الأرض التي نحن عليها
branches.source_phrase_ar: فلان ابن أرض أي غريب (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi nesneyi kalın, büyükçe bir yaygı olarak tanımlar ve malzemesini yün ya da hayvan kılıyla sınırlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal genel yer, hasır, döşek veya süslü kumaş değil; malzemesi ve kalınlığı belirtilmiş bir yaygıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın adın kanıtlanan nesne anlamıyla sınırlıdır ve komşu döşeme türlerinin özelliklerini içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Yünden veya hayvan kılından yapılmış kalın ve büyükçe bir yaygıdır.

facets.statement: Nesne, yün ya da hayvan kılından yapılmış kalın bir yaygıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar nesnenin yaygı oluşunda, kalınlığında ve yün ya da hayvan kılından yapılmasında birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Nesnenin türünü, belirleyici kalınlığını ve iki olası malzemesini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yaygı türünü, kalın yapıyı ve yün ya da hayvan kılı malzemesini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yaygının kalın ve özellikle yün ya da hayvan kılından yapılmış olmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Döşek, yatak örtüsü ve genel olarak alta serilen nesneleri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da zemine ya da yatma yerine serilen ev eşyalarını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal malzeme ve kalınlıkla tanımlanan belirli bir yaygıdır; komşu dal işlevi bakımından daha geniş bir döşeme sınıfıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sağlanan kartların tümü değerlendirildi; nesne türü bakımından en yakın fakat kapsamı daha geniş döşeme komşusu yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: الإراض بالكسر؛ بساط ضخم من وبر أو صوف

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişinin yere bağlı kalmasını, yere doğru ağırlaşmasını ve bunun sonucu oyalanıp gecikmesini aynı hareket durumu içinde verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yere yönelen ağırlık ve kalma durumudur; tembellik, geri kayma veya bir başkasına karşı çıkma değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın eylem dalının yere bağlı kalma, ağırlaşma ve gecikme bileşenleriyle sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin yere bağlı kalmasını veya yere çökercesine ağırlaşmasını ve bu yüzden bir süre oyalanıp gecikmesini anlatır.

facets.statement: Kişi yerden ayrılmayarak yere bağlı kalır.
Yere doğru ağırlaşma, oyalanma ve gecikme olarak gerçekleşebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, yere bağlı kalmayı çekirdek alır ve yere doğru ağırlaşma ile oyalanmayı bu durumun görünüşleri olarak birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yere bağlılık, ağırlaşma ve gecikme bileşenlerini tek bir eylem karşılığında toplar.

error_profile.preserves: Yere yönelişi, ağırlığı, yerinde kalmayı ve bunun doğurduğu oyalanmayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin doğrudan yere bağlı kalması öne çıktığında kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Yere bağlı kalma ve bulunduğu noktadan ayrılmama durumunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Yere doğru ağırlaşma ile oyalanıp gecikme görünüşlerini dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İnsan için yere doğru ağırlaşma ve bununla birlikte oyalanma anlamını taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İnsan dışında kuş ve yırtıcıları, ayrıca yuva ve yerinde ağır duran nesne örneklerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da yere yakın durma ve bulunulan yerden ayrılmama durumu vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kişinin yere doğru ağırlaşıp gecikmesini anlatır; komşu dal farklı canlı ve nesnelerde yere yapışma ya da sabit kalma alanına daha geniş yayılır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; yere bağlı kalma çekirdeğini en doğrudan paylaşan ve kapsam farkını gösteren komşu seçildi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynak ifadesi eylemi, birine doğru çıkıp onun karşısında kendini ortaya koymak ve ona karşı durmak biçiminde açıklar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bir başkasına yönelmiş karşı duruşu anlatır; yere çökme, ağırlaşma veya yalnızca yüz yüze bulunma değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın eylem dalını, bir hedefe yönelme ve karşısına çıkma koşullarıyla sınırlar.

facets.statement: Kişi bir başkasına yönelir, karşısına çıkar ve kendini ona karşı ortaya koyar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kanıt, eylemin hedefe yönelmiş bir karşıya çıkma ve kendini ortaya koyma hareketi olduğunu gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişiye yönelmiş karşı duruşu ve görünür biçimde ortaya çıkmayı birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Hedefe yönelme, karşısına çıkma ve kendini açıkça ortaya koyma bileşenlerini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir kişiye doğru gelerek onun karşısında kendini ortaya koyma hareketini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeye bakmak üzere yükselme, onu gözetme veya yalnızca yüzünü ona çevirme kapsamına uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir hedefe yönelme ve onun karşısında konum alma anlamını taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kişiler arası karşıya çıkışı öne çıkarır; komşu dal bakma, gözetme ve genel yüzünü dönme kullanımlarını da kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm komşular değerlendirildi; yönelme ve karşıya çıkma çekirdeğini en yakından paylaşan aday yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı insanda görülen titreme, sarsılma veya ürperme olarak açıkça tanımlar ve yer ya da hastalık anlamlarından ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel şiddetli sarsıntı veya belirli bir ateş nöbeti değil, insanda görülen titreme durumudur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın biçimlerin insandaki titreme ve ürperme anlamıyla sınırlıdır; komşu hastalık nedenleri eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın bedeninde beliren titreme, sarsılma veya ürperme durumudur.

facets.statement: İnsan bedenini tutan bir titreme veya ürperme meydana gelir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu adın insanda görülen titreme ve ürperme durumunu bildirdiğinde birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan bedenindeki kısa ya da süren sarsıntı durumunu doğrudan karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: İnsan bedenini tutan titreme, sarsılma ve ürperme durumunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İnsan bedenindeki titreme durumunu herhangi bir özel neden belirtmeden adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da insan bedenindeki titreme ve sarsılma alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yalın bir insan titremesidir; komşu dal nedeni ve öznesi bakımından daha geniştir, ayrıca korkaklık ve gevşeklik nitelemelerine uzanır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sağlanan bütün kartlar incelendi; genel titreme çekirdeğine en yakın ve kapsam farkı belirgin olan komşu seçildi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hastalığı soğuk algınlığı olarak, etkilenen kişiyi bu hastalığa yakalanmış olarak ve ettirgen biçimi hastalığa uğratmak olarak verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal solunumla ilgili başka hastalıkları veya genel beden titremesini değil, soğuk algınlığı durumunu ve ilgili türevleri kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın hastalık adını ve aynı dalda kanıtlanan hasta kişi ile hastalığa uğratma türevlerini korur.

concept_map.definition: Soğuk algınlığı hastalığını, bu hastalığa yakalanmış kişiyi ve birini bu hastalığa uğratma eylemini anlatır.

facets.statement: Soğuk algınlığı durumudur.
Türemiş biçim, soğuk algınlığına yakalanmış kişiyi niteler.
Ettirgen biçim, birini soğuk algınlığına uğratmayı bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar hastalık adı ile hasta kişi nitelemesinde birleşir; kanıt ayrıca hastalığa uğratma eylemini aynı türetim alanında gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın hastalık çekirdeğini Türkçede en doğal ve ayırt edici biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Belirtilen hastalık durumunu ve ona bağlı hasta kişi ile ettirgen türetimlerin temelini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hastalığın kendisi değil, bu hastalığa tutulmuş kişi nitelendiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Soğuk algınlığı ile kişi arasındaki etkilenme ilişkisini korur.
error_profile.loses: Hastalık adını ve birini hastalığa uğratma eylemini bağımsız olarak karşılamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hastalık adı, hastaya ilişkin niteleme ve hastalığa uğratma eylemini birlikte kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Soğuk algınlığı yanında daha genel bir hastalık alanına açılan ayrı bir kaynak yorumunu da taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal soğuk algınlığını ve bu hastalığa yakalanmış kişiyi ifade eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın türetim dizisinde hastalığa uğratma da vardır; komşu dalın kanıtı ise bir kaynakta daha genel hastalık yorumu içerir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün komşu kartları değerlendirildi; aynı hastalık ve hasta kişi alanını en doğrudan paylaşan aday yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi beyaz, karıncaya benzeyen ve odun yiyen küçük canlıyı tanımlar; ayrıca bu canlının odunu yiyerek onu zarar görmüş hale getirmesini verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Canlının kendisi çekirdektir; odunun yenmiş duruma gelmesi yalnız belirtilen eylem yapısına bağlı sonuçtur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım canlı adını yalın çekirdek olarak verir ve odunun yenmesini yalnız kanıtlanan tamlamaya bağlı sonuç yüzü olarak ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Odun yiyen küçük bir canlıyı belirtir. İlgili eylem yapısı, bu canlının bir odunu yiyip zarar görmüş hale getirmesini anlatır.

facets.statement: Küçük canlı odunla beslenir.
Canlı odunu yiyerek onu aşınmış ve zarar görmüş hale getirir.
Bir kaynak canlıyı beyaz ve karıncaya benzer olarak niteler.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar odun yiyen küçük canlı ile onun odunda oluşturduğu yenme ve zarar görme sonucunu aynı anlam alanında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Canlıyı kanıtlanan boyutu ve onu ayırt eden beslenme davranışıyla kısa ve doğal biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Küçük canlıyı, odun yeme davranışını ve bunun oduna verdiği zararı korur.

contextual_glosses.text: odun yiyen küçük canlı tarafından yenmiş
contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir odunun bu canlı tarafından yenerek zarar görmüş olduğu bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Odunun canlı tarafından yenmiş ve zarar görmüş olma sonucunu korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynak ifadesi, yaranın irin toplamasıyla kabarıp bozulmasını bir süreç olarak verir; yalnız irin maddesini veya genel deri şişliğini adlandırmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız yara ile kurulan yapıda geçerlidir ve irinlenmenin yol açtığı bozulmayı zorunlu olarak içerir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız yara öznesiyle kurulan kanıtlanmış tamlamaya bağlıdır; yalın biçime genel bozulma anlamı verilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir yaranın irin toplaması, kabarıp su toplaması ve bu irinlenme yüzünden bozulmasıdır.

facets.statement: Yara irin toplayarak kabarır ve irinlenme sonucunda bozulur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kanıt, yara içindeki irinlenme ile kabarma ve bozulmayı birbirine bağlı tek bir hastalık süreci olarak gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız yara bağlamında irin toplama ile ortaya çıkan bozulma sürecini eksiksiz karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yaranın irin toplamasını, kabarmasını ve bunun sonucunda bozulmasını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yaranın irinlenmeyle kabarıp bozulması sürecini zorunlu olarak içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İrinin yarada toplanmasını veya yaradan çıkmasını, bozulma sonucu aramadan kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yaranın içinde irin birikmesi durumunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal irin birikimini yaranın kabarıp bozulmasına bağlar; komşu dal yalnız irin toplanması ya da dışarı çıkmasıyla yetinebilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün komşular incelendi; irin birikmesi çekirdeğini en yakından paylaşan ve sonuç bakımından ayrılan kart yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız akıl karışıklığı değildir; doğaüstü nedene bağlanma ve istemsiz baş-gövde hareketi birlikte korunmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın kişi nitelemesinin doğaüstü açıklama, akıl bozukluğu ve istemsiz beden hareketi bileşenleriyle sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Yerle ilişkilendirilen görünmez varlıkların etkisine bağlanan bir akıl ve beden bozukluğudur; etkilenen kişi başını ve gövdesini isteği dışında hareket ettirir.

facets.statement: Kişinin akıl ve beden durumu görünmez varlıkların etkisine bağlanır.
Etkilenen kişi başını ve gövdesini bilinçli bir amaç olmadan hareket ettirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kanıt, doğaüstü varlıklara bağlanan akıl karışıklığını ve istemsiz baş-gövde hareketini aynı kişi durumunun ayrılmaz parçaları olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Neden yorumunu, akıl durumunu ve belirleyici istemsiz beden hareketini birlikte açıklar.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Doğaüstü bir dokunuşla açıklanan akıl karışıklığını beden hareketi koşulu olmadan daha genel verir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da akıl bozukluğunu görünmez bir varlığın etkisiyle açıklayan geleneksel anlayışta buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli bir kaynak ilişkilendirmesi ve istemsiz baş-gövde hareketi gerektirir; komşu dal daha genel bir doğaüstü dokunuş açıklamasıdır.
